rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: An MCP server providing comprehensive cloud region data across 14 major providers including AWS, Azure, GCP, Oracle Cloud, DigitalOcean, Linode, Vultr, and specialized providers like Crusoe, CoreWeave, and Lambda Labs. Covers 267 regions with tools for discovery and filtering by provider, country, compliance certifications (HIPAA, GDPR), GPU availability, and carbon neutrality. Includes geospatial capabilities for finding nearby regions by coordinates, listing countries and cities with cloud presence, and distance-based optimization. Enables multi-provider coverage comparison for infrastructure planning.
